$comment: Minutes to move everyone out. base = fixed overhead (muster, transport arrival, sweep). perPerson scales with occupancy. Hackathon assumptions — the UI shows them and the agent repeats the caveat.

care_home.note: Low mobility, high dependency, 24 h occupancy.

hospital.note: Also a response asset: losing it removes capacity mid-incident.

nursery.note: Occupants have no independent evacuation capability.

campsite.note: Tourists do not know the roads.

population_cell.note: Informational only. Households are not ranked as sites.

livestock.$comment: Animals cannot self-evacuate, so lead time is the whole problem. Minutes per 100 livestock units by species group.
livestock.maxMinutesNote: Beyond twelve hours the answer is not evacuation, it is defend-in-place with Bombers. Capping keeps the ranking honest.
